findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: enrich_profile, get_task_results, get_bulk_email_results · Private data: enrich_profile · Public sink: query_email, get_task_results, bulk_query_email, get_bulk_email_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: enrich_profile, get_task_results, get_bulk_email_results · Private data: enrich_profile · Public sink: query_email, get_task_results, bulk_query_email, get_bulk_email_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
